papers_read.title_as_printed: Predicting long-term progression of Alzheimer's disease using a multimodal deep learning model incorporating interaction effects (Wang et al., J Transl Med 2024)
Leveraging hemispheric asymmetry in structural MRI with an attention-guided 3D CNN for early prediction of Alzheimer's conversion (Liu et al., Neural Networks 2026)

what_each_reports.P-273: DISFC trimodal deep model (3D sMRI + 14 demographic/cognitive features incl. MMSE, CDRSB, ADAS11/13, RAVLT, FAQ, mPACC + 49 selected SNPs), 238 ADNI-1/GO/2 MCI (plus 45 AD added to training), conversion within 48 months, stratified 10-fold CV: AUC 0.962 (SD 0.041), accuracy 92.92%; ADNI-3 independent test (n=14, 3 pMCI) AUC 0.939 (95% CI 0.796-1.000). Unimodal/bimodal results are shown only in Fig. 4B (values not in the extract).
what_each_reports.P-65: HemiNet 3D CNN on single-time-point structural MRI only, 573 right-handed ADNI MCI (300 pMCI, 273 sMCI), conversion within 36 months, 5-fold stratified CV repeated 5 times: AUC 0.8401 +/- 0.0297, accuracy 0.7819; external OASIS-3 (n=144) AUC 0.8137 +/- 0.0351.

quantity_a: ROC-AUC for MCI-to-AD conversion within 48 months, ADNI, predictors = sMRI + cognitive/clinical scores + SNPs (trimodal), 10-fold CV
quantity_b: ROC-AUC for MCI-to-AD conversion within 36 months, ADNI, predictor = structural MRI only, repeated 5-fold CV
incompatible_if_same: Not incompatible in kind: a model given cognitive scores and genotypes outscoring an MRI-only model is the expected ordering, and P-273 itself reports that removing modalities lowers performance. Neither paper claims an ordering the other refutes.

gates.task: match in label (T2) but horizon differs: 48 months vs 36 months.
gates.dataset_family: match: both ADNI (overlapping ADNI-1/GO/2 participants likely).
gates.validation_tier: match for the quoted figures: both internal cross-validation (each also has a small or separate external test: ADNI-3 n=14; OASIS-3 n=144).
gates.modality_family: mismatch in predictor set: P-273 trimodal (MRI + neuropsychological scores + SNPs); P-65 structural MRI only.

endpoint_and_metric: partly compatible: both ROC-AUC, but different conversion horizons (48 vs 36 months) and different predictor sets.
performance_validity: flag does not apply by the rule: 0.962 is below 0.97 and there is an (n=14) independent test; the external test is too small to be informative (95% CI 0.796-1.000), which is a caution but not the exclusion criterion.
independence: Distinct groups (Shanghai Jiao Tong vs Chongqing Normal/Chongqing Medical University); both use ADNI MCI participants, so cohort overlap is likely (non-independence).
grounds: P-273's 0.962 comes from a trimodal model that includes cognitive test scores and genotypes, while P-65's 0.8401 comes from structural MRI alone, so the predictor sets differ.
The conversion horizons differ (48 months vs 36 months).
With predictor set and horizon both different and no waiver on record, the two AUCs are not the same quantity.

evidence_quotes.quote: On the cross-validation set, our model achieved superior results for predicting MCI conversion within 4 years (AUC, 0.962; accuracy, 92.92%; sensitivity, 88.89%; specificity, 95.33%)
a multimodal deep learning model based on 3D sMRI scans, demographic and neuropsychological assessments, and genetic polymorphism data to predict the risk of MCI progression to AD at baseline.
The trimodal DISFC model was superior to the top-performing bimodal model using MRI and clinical data with a significant increase of 0.022 (P = 0.048) in AUC
participants in the pMCI group were initially diagnosed with MCI at baseline and converted to AD within 36 months of follow-up
Extensive experiments and cross-validation on the ADNI dataset demonstrate that HemiNet achieves an AUC of 84.01% and an accuracy of 78.19% for MCI prediction.

record_defects: resolution_note 'Same architecture family (A4_transformer)' is wrong: neither model is a transformer (P-273 is a separable-convolution/residual CNN with FC fusion; P-65 is a 3D DenseNet-121 CNN with SE-style attention).
claim_b 'AUC 84.01%' mixes percent and proportion notation; the paper's value is 0.8401.
The record treats the pair as same-modality (structural_mri) although P-273's figure depends on cognitive scores and SNPs as well as MRI.
P-273 registry Validation_Type V3 rests on a 14-subject ADNI-3 test; the quoted 0.962 is the internal CV figure.
what_would_change_the_verdict: P-273's MRI-only unimodal AUC at 48 months (Fig. 4B; not in the extract) compared with an MRI-only P-65 AUC at the same horizon with non-overlapping uncertainty; even then the horizons differ by a year.
